name: PipeToMHSchedule
formula: =LAMBDA(CMH,USMH,DSMH,USIL,DSIL,PipeDia,PipeMat,REDUCE(HSTACK("MH","Inlet I.L.","Inlet Pipe Dia","Inlet Pipe Material","Inlet From MH","Outlet I.L.","Outlet Pipe Dia","Outlet Pipe Material","Outlet To MH"),CMH,LAMBDA(a,b,VSTACK(a,{ref}GetMHInfoFromPipeSch(b,USMH,DSMH,USIL,DSIL,PipeDia,PipeMat)))))
comment: Returns a manhole schedule from a pipe schedule. Arguments: CMH, USMH, DSMH, USIL, DSIL, PipeDia, PipeMat. CMH is the column of manholes to list. The other arguments are the pipe-schedule columns. The first row is the header. Each following block is GetMHInfoFromPipeSch for that manhole. Omitting CMH returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
